identity.title: Multi-Lane Alpha Factory Core
identity.objective: Build the first canonical Alpha Factory research-memory substrate: a standalone, deterministic, bounded, local/offline record model (alpha_factory.py) and a separate append-only SQLite registry (alpha_factory_registry.py, application id 1464877425, distinct from WP170's 1464877424) exported from the analytical_research package. Four frozen content-addressed record types record public/research source references, research-worthy opportunity candidates, hypothesis/mechanism families, and immutable research episodes with primitive multi-lane evidence (COMPOSITE derived, not stored), nine closed result states with a per-state evidence matrix, exact-scope negative evidence, append-only reopen lineage, deterministic novelty/mechanism fingerprints (prose/producer excluded), producer provenance, recursive secret/authority/binary-float rejection, a PUBLIC_HTTPS URL boundary, and a per-entry SHA-256 hash chain with caller-order-independent atomic append. Alpha Factory records research history only; deterministic qualification and economic authority remain outside this package. Unlocked by GENUINE_H1_PASS (accepted H1 #4; historical real H1 invocations 4; H1 #5 NOT AUTHORIZED; remote Firecrawl HTTP independently proven NO). WP170 is unchanged; no Hermes runtime import; no network; no scheduler; no prioritization; no economics. Merge remains Karl-only and is not authorized by this package.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert WP175N. The two new source modules (alpha_factory.py, alpha_factory_registry.py), their package exports, the four focused test modules, the canonical contract doc, the WP175N package records, and the additive current-truth doc updates are removed. No provider, Firecrawl, OAuth, order, Gate-C, wallet, paper, live, or economic state exists to unwind; WP170 (application id 1464877424) and the frozen H1 request identity are untouched; the separate Alpha registry application id 1464877425 leaves no trace outside caller-selected .sqlite3 files.

api_matrix.reason: WP175N adds a local/offline deterministic Python record/registry API in src/data_layer/analytical_research; it adds no provider/model/Hermes/Firecrawl/OAuth/network surface and no economic/qualification/execution surface.

items.before: No Alpha Factory record model existed.
items.after: Four deterministic builders return frozen content-addressed advisory-only records with recursive bounded validation; invalid inputs fail closed with a closed ALPHA_ERROR_CODES vocabulary and never echo rejected content.
items.compatibility_requirement: No network, provider, wallet, economic, qualification, prioritization, or scheduler surface is added; identical inputs yield identical record identities; WP170 types are not reused.

items.after: A bounded append-only SQLite registry (format s10-alpha-factory-registry, integer schema version 1, application id 1464877425) with a per-entry SHA-256 hash chain, append-only triggers, caller-order-independent atomic append, projected-history cross-reference validation, and read-only verified load.
items.compatibility_requirement: Distinct from WP170's application id 1464877424; explicit caller .sqlite3 path only; no network, no implicit init on append, no UPDATE/DELETE public API; a rejected batch leaves the store byte-unchanged.

items.before: The package exported only WP167/WP170 surfaces.

semantic_fields.reason: Content identity, novelty/mechanism fingerprints, primitive lanes, the result-state evidence matrix, append-only reopen, sensitive-key rejection, the registry hash chain and caller-order independence, the unique application id, WP170 separation, and the non-authority posture must be provably deterministic and must never broaden authority.

items.required_rule: each record id is SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of the COMPLETE logical semantic record excluding ONLY its own content-addressed id field; the advisory/no-authority booleans and public_research_only/human_review_required therefore participate in identity, and one semantic field change changes the id
items.validation_rule: same input -> same id; one field change (including an authority boolean) -> different id; sqlite sequence/rowid/path/write-time/pid/host/env/session never enter identity because they are not record fields

items.required_rule: novelty_fingerprint hashes the closed structured novelty dimensions (subject_keys, scope_key, mechanism_key) plus the canonical primitive evidence-lane tuple; title/thesis prose is excluded
items.validation_rule: prose variants share the fingerprint; structured-dimension change alters it; a non-identical candidate with the same fingerprint conflicts as NOVELTY_DUPLICATE

items.required_rule: mechanism_fingerprint hashes only mechanism_key and mechanism_dimensions_json; producer/provider/model/prose/path/registry-sequence/environment are excluded
items.validation_rule: producer/name/theme changes do not alter it; a non-identical family with the same fingerprint conflicts as MECHANISM_CONFLICT

items.required_rule: evidence lanes are a non-empty primitive set from a closed six-lane vocabulary; COMPOSITE is not stored; is_multi_lane is derived as len(evidence_lanes) >= 2
items.validation_rule: unknown/duplicate lanes reject; lane input order does not change stored lanes or identity

items.required_rule: each of the nine closed result states requires its specific non-empty supporting evidence, plus global non-empty falsification checks and at least one evidence reference
items.validation_rule: a state missing its required field fails closed RESULT_EVIDENCE_INVALID; EXECUTION_UNECONOMIC requires a deterministic evidence ref and ALPHA-01 computes no economics

items.required_rule: a REOPEN_TRIGGERED episode references a prior episode of the same candidate/family whose state is not RESEARCH_SUPPORTIVE or REOPEN_TRIGGERED; no old record is mutated
items.validation_rule: reopen appends a new immutable episode; wrong candidate/family/target-state rejects REOPEN_INVALID; negative evidence binds to exact scope/regime and never globalizes

items.required_rule: every caller free-form mapping is bounded and rejects secret-like and authority-like keys case-insensitively and binary floats recursively, never echoing rejected content
items.validation_rule: nested secret/authority keys reject FORBIDDEN_CONTENT with record None and no echoed value; a float at any depth rejects FIELD_TYPE_INVALID

items.required_rule: the registry is append-only with a per-entry SHA-256 hash chain and UPDATE/DELETE triggers; every load re-verifies the contiguous chain and record identities
items.validation_rule: payload/entry-hash/previous-hash/sequence tampering yields REGISTRY_INTEGRITY_TAMPER; verified load never alters file bytes

items.required_rule: caller batch order never affects committed bytes; canonical kind rank plus predecessor/reopen topological order determines sequence; one bad record rolls back the whole batch
items.validation_rule: batch permutations yield identical head hash; a dependency cycle fails LINEAGE_CYCLE; a rejected batch leaves head hash and row count unchanged

items.required_rule: the Alpha registry application id is 1464877425, proven unique and distinct from WP170's 1464877424
items.validation_rule: PRAGMA application_id equals 1464877425, user_version 1, journal_mode DELETE; a foreign/nonconforming file is rejected and never overwritten

items.required_rule: WP170 experiment_os/experiment_registry and application id 1464877424 are unchanged; no WP170 type, kind, or application id is reused; HypothesisFamily is not ExperimentFamily
items.validation_rule: the Alpha modules import no WP170 record types for canonical Alpha types; WP170 focused suites remain green with WP170 source unchanged

items.required_rule: the package grants no provider/model/Hermes runtime, network, wallet, market, scheduler, prioritization, qualification, economic, strategy, paper, live, credential, signing, order, or Gate-C authority; every record and result carries advisory_only, no_execution_authority, no_strategy_authority, and no_qualification_authority exactly true
items.validation_rule: AST/import checks prove no Hermes/research_runtime/network import; authority booleans are re-validated as exactly true; Gate C remains NOT AUTHORIZED
